summary: Antalpha issued a press release announcing its participation in the XAUE protocol, committing 6,052 XAU units (approx. $29M) to enable yield on gold holdings. This is a business development and capital allocation announcement, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation category applies. The filing is a routine Form 6-K furnished to the SEC under cover of a foreign private issuer report.
